        current.u_ai_retry_time_out = '';

    if (retryCount >= maxRetries) {

        current.u_ai_retry_time_out = '';
        return;

    var retryTime = new GlideDateTime();

        if (current.u_ai_human_review_required == true) {
            current.u_ai_processing_state = 'awaiting_Approval';
            current.u_ai_retry_time_out = '';
            return;
        }

        var retryCount = parseInt(current.u_ai_retry_count || 0, 10);
        var maxRetries = parseInt(current.u_ai_max_retries || 3, 10);

        if (retryCount >= maxRetries) {

            current.u_ai_retry_time_out = '';
            return;
        }

        // Schedule the next retry 5 minutes from now.
        var retryTime = new GlideDateTime();
        retryTime.addMinutes(5);

        current.u_ai_retry_time_out = retryTime;
        current.u_ai_processing_state = 'waiting_for_retry';
